name: io.github.Dennis5882/midas-nx-mcp
title: MIDAS Gen NX / Civil NX
description: Read and carefully change the model open in MIDAS Gen NX or Civil NX on this PC.

environmentVariables.name: MIDAS_MAPI_KEY_GEN
environmentVariables.description: Gen NX MAPI key (Apps > API Settings in Gen NX). Needed for product=gen.

environmentVariables.name: MIDAS_MAPI_KEY_CIVIL
environmentVariables.description: Civil NX MAPI key (Apps > API Settings in Civil NX). Needed for product=civil.

environmentVariables.name: MIDAS_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder NX writes captures and saved copies into. Must exist. Default C:/temp.
